fields.statement: At 907c325a, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/dispatch-check$' -v passes: the script runs rhiza check passing with no .rhiza/dispatch.toml, with [request] bug naming a repo workflow in .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml, and with [ready] feature naming the built-in ship-change; and failing with stdout 'dispatch.toml: request.bug names workflow "nothing-here"', with 'dispatch.toml: ready.milestone names workflow "personal-only"' while that workflow exists only in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rhiza/workflows set inside the script, and with 'unknown table [reqest]'. describe-golden passes with the new dispatch rule; internal/check, internal/dispatch and the api Check/Dispatch/Workflow tests pass. Diff read: dispatchProblems in internal/api/check.go resolves names only by os.Stat under .rhiza/workflows and workflow.Builtin, never the personal layer; findings carry rule dispatch, path .rhiza/dispatch.toml and severity fail. The full internal/api package went past a 240s timeout under load with no test failing, a pre-existing slowness and not this diff.
